links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of chatbot responses to parent queries
links.effect: Mean Flesch Reading Ease score was 28.4 ± 15.0 (college-graduate level); responses accurate (mean 4.9 ± 0.5) but reading level potentially challenging for some users.
links.quote: Chatbot responses were accurate yet written at a reading level potentially challenging for some users.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating parent interaction and query characteristics using a HIPAA-compliant LLM chatbot during think-aloud sessions, without testing a comparative deployment safeguard.
